title: A bundle includes unused tickets
hook: Five-ticket bundles can force a second bundle for the sixth trip.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Compare exact-demand tickets with indivisible ticket bundles.

misconception: A discounted bundle is cheaper for every required trip count.
objective: Compare exact-demand tickets with indivisible ticket bundles.

claims.text: Fictional singles cost €2. A five-ticket bundle costs €8 and cannot be split; leftover tickets are unused here. Scaled model; fictional fares; leftover value=0; no recommendation.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Trips=6, A=€12 and B=€16. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
